title: Introducing Agriculture and Its Global Variations

tasks.task_text: Describe the relationship between climate and agricultural practices.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the relationship between climate and agricultural practices.
subtasks.text: Observe how farmers in cold mid-latitude climates grow wheat and barley and have a variety of livestock.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the relationship between climate and agricultural practices.
subtasks.text: Note the production of fruits and rice in warm mid-latitude climates, such as southern China and the southern United States.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the relationship between climate and agricultural practices.
subtasks.text: Highlight the cultivation of grapes, olives, and dates in Mediterranean climates, as seen in California and the Mediterranean Sea region.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the relationship between climate and agricultural practices.
subtasks.text: Look at the production of coffee, sugar, and tea in tropical climates, exemplified by Indonesia.

tasks.task_text: Explain the impact of technology on agriculture.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the impact of technology on agriculture.
subtasks.text: Observe the use of genetic modification to grow plants larger and faster than before.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the impact of technology on agriculture.
subtasks.text: Notice the application of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides to increase crop yields and nutrient levels in the soil.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the impact of technology on agriculture.
subtasks.text: Describe the creation of greenhouses to extend growing seasons and vertical farming in urban areas to combat food deserts.

tasks.task_text: Differentiate between intensive and extensive agriculture.

subtasks.task_text: Differentiate between intensive and extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Observe the characteristics of intensive agriculture, which require less land but more capital and labor.

subtasks.task_text: Differentiate between intensive and extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Identify intensive agriculture systems, such as plantation farming and mixed crop and livestock, located near urban areas.

subtasks.task_text: Differentiate between intensive and extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Describe the economic aspects of intensive agriculture and how farms can maximize profits by growing cash crops.

tasks.task_text: Describe the characteristics of extensive agriculture.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the characteristics of extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Note shifting cultivation, which is found in tropical climates, such as Latin America, Sub-Saharan Africa, or Southeast Asia.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the characteristics of extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Observe the practice of nomadic herding, traditionally located in dry climates in Central and Southwest Asia and North Africa.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the characteristics of extensive agriculture.
subtasks.text: Describe ranching, which is traditionally located on less suitable land and further from urban centers to reduce costs and become more profitable.
